manifest.name: dsh-approval-watch
manifest.description: Floating overlay that surfaces pending approvals, plan reviews and user questions from any session, with click-through to the session.
manifest.author: r-ayin

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch layer for dsh-approval-watch (全局审批提醒浮窗).
# 由 dev_inject_plugin 注入时经 loader.create 生效；此 patch 行供重建 profile 时恢复装配。
- insert:
    - id: dsh-approval-watch
      name: dsh-approval-watch

readme.text:
Global approval / question reminder overlay for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).

When any session has a pending tool approval, a plan review, or a user question, a persistent floating overlay pops up at the bottom-right of the DSH web UI (draggable, collapsible). Clicking an entry jumps straight to the session that needs you, so approvals never stall the flow because they are out of sight.

- The host half (`lib/index.js`) is intentionally empty — all behavior lives in the browser half (`lib/client.js`), which registers a shell overlay entry.
- The `dsh.client` manifest injects the browser half into the web client runtime.
Install it from the **DSH Plugin Market** (Settings → Plugin Market), or add it to your profile bundle stack manually — see `cordis.patch.yml`. Prebuilt; no build step required.
